applied.problem: Some rules are too absolute: sources are listed as the only kinds; symbols are not always drawn normal (some three-way valves are drawn in their fail position); a stopped generator can still be started; and the sources step finds only what the sheet shows.
The sources step should count stopped sources too, since a stopped generator can be started; otherwise a line joined only to it may be taken as dead, which is unsafe.
It says real open breakers can let a little through, which is not why you prove dead at low voltage; the real reasons are valves letting by and a way in the sheet does not show.
Screen 13 says the sources step finds every way in, but screen 14 shows a way in the sheet does not show; the step looks for every way in, it cannot promise to find one that is not drawn.
